title: 第19章 收账成功第20章 楚家姐妹
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
桃夭快步走到陈阳身前，微微躬身，语气恭敬说：“陈少，让你久等了，梅姐让我来帮你，解救你的朋友。”
陈阳点了点头，目光转向肖明轩，眼神冷了下来。
肖明轩却猛地站起身，瞪着桃夭，脸上满是愤怒和威胁，咬牙问：“你们梅姐是真的要与我作对？
就不怕我哥回来，要了你们的命，把你们梅兰山庄夷为平地吗？”
桃夭面不改色，语气平静说：“肖少，我们梅姐也不想与你作对，只是这陈先生和他的朋友，对我们有恩，我们必须要把他们带走，还望肖少通融。”
肖明轩气得浑身发抖，咬紧牙关，怒视着众人：“你们敢？
我看谁敢动她们一下！”
桃夭不再多言，看了一眼身边的手下，沉声下令：“动手！把人救出来！”
十多名西装男女应声而动，瞬间扑向肖明轩那三名保镖和两名保安。
一时间，大厅里棍棒挥舞，叫声此起彼伏。
除了那三名保镖抗打能力稍强一些，还能勉强支撑外，两名保安很快就被打得鼻青脸肿，瘫倒在地。
那三名保镖也渐渐落了下风，被打得连连后退，毫无还手之力。
陈阳连忙冲到宋萌萌身前，语气急切问：“嫂子，你没事吧？有没有受伤？”
宋萌萌摇了摇头，眼眶通红，情绪异常激动，眼泪在眼眶里打转，却强忍着没有掉下来。
她连忙看向身边同样被解救的少女，伸手抓住她的肩膀，语气安抚：“没事了，别怕，我们获救了。”
肖明轩看着这一幕，气得肺都要炸了，直接大喊道：“够了！都给我住手！”
桃夭见状，立刻示意手下收手。
十多名西装男女停下了动作，纷纷退到桃夭身后。
桃夭冲肖明轩抱了抱拳，语气依旧恭敬：“肖少，多有得罪，还望海涵。”
她转头看了一眼陈阳和宋萌萌，又扫了一眼自己的手下，沉声说，“我们走。”

肖明轩一时怒到了极点，咬紧牙关，脸色铁青，正要发火。
就在这时，陈阳突然一个箭步，猛地扑到了肖明轩身前，手中那把锋利的菜刀，直接架在他脖子上。
肖明轩吓了一跳，身体猛地一僵。
桃夭和宋萌萌等人也都露出了意外的神色。
肖明轩强压下恐惧，声音有些发颤，却依旧嘴硬：“你……你想干什么？你敢杀了我？”
陈阳没有看他，而是从口袋里掏出那张皱巴巴的1200万欠条，递到肖明轩的面前，眼神冰冷，一字一句说：“肖少，你应该认得这个欠条吧？”
肖明轩垂眸看着陈阳递到眼前的欠条，脸上满是意外，语气带着几分难以置信：“你……你还是苏氏集团的人？”
陈阳眼神冰冷，语气笃定：“是。
现在，马上把这笔欠款还清，别逼我动手。”
content_en:
Tao Yao walked quickly to Chen Yang, bowed slightly, and said in a respectful tone: "Mr. Chen, I kept you waiting for a long time. Sister Mei asked me to help you and rescue your friend."
Chen Yang nodded, turned to Xiao Mingxuan, and his eyes became cold.
Xiao Mingxuan stood up suddenly, stared at Taoyao, his face full of anger and threats, gritted his teeth and asked: "Sister Mei, do you really want to go against me?
Aren't you afraid that my brother will come back, kill you, and raze your Meilan Villa to the ground? "
Tao Yao's face did not change and she said calmly: "Master Xiao, our sister Mei doesn't want to go against you. It's just that Mr. Chen and his friends are kind to us. We must take them away. I hope Master Xiao will be accommodating."
Xiao Mingxuan was so angry that he was shaking all over, gritted his teeth, and glared at everyone: "You dare?
Let's see who dares to touch them! "
Tao Yao said no more, glanced at the men beside him, and ordered in a deep voice: "Do it! Rescue the people!"
More than a dozen men and women in suits responded and immediately pounced on Xiao Mingxuan's three bodyguards and two security guards.
For a time, sticks were waved in the hall and shouts arose one after another.
Except for the three bodyguards who were slightly stronger in resisting the beating and could barely hold on, the two security guards were soon beaten until their noses were bruised and their faces were swollen, and they collapsed to the ground.
The three bodyguards were gradually at a disadvantage and were beaten back repeatedly, unable to fight back.
Chen Yang rushed to Song Mengmeng and asked urgently: "Sister-in-law, are you okay? Are you injured?"
Song Mengmeng shook her head, her eyes were red, she was extremely emotional, tears were rolling in her eyes, but she resisted falling.
She quickly looked at the girl beside her who was also rescued, reached out and grabbed her shoulders, and said in a soothing tone: "It's okay, don't be afraid, we are rescued."
Xiao Mingxuan looked at this scene and was so angry that his lungs were about to explode. He shouted directly: "That's enough! Stop it!"
When Tao Yao saw this, he immediately signaled his men to stop.
More than a dozen men and women in suits stopped moving and retreated behind Tao Yao.
Tao Yao hugged Xiao Mingxuan's fists, her tone still respectful: "Young Master Xiao, I have offended you so much, but I still hope Haihan."
She turned her head and glanced at Chen Yang and Song Mengmeng, then glanced at her men, and said in a deep voice, "Let's go."
Xiao Mingxuan was so angry that he clenched his teeth, his face turned livid, and he was about to get angry.
At this moment, Chen Yang suddenly lunged in front of Xiao Mingxuan, and put the sharp kitchen knife directly on his neck.
Xiao Mingxuan was startled and his body stiffened suddenly.
Tao Yao, Song Mengmeng and others also looked surprised.
Xiao Mingxuan suppressed his fear, his voice was trembling, but he still said harshly: "You...what do you want to do? Do you dare to kill me?"
Chen Yang did not look at him, but took out the crumpled 12 million IOU from his pocket and handed it to Xiao Mingxuan. His eyes were cold and he said word by word: "Master Xiao, you should recognize this IOU, right?"
Xiao Mingxuan lowered his eyes and looked at the IOU handed to him by Chen Yang. His face was full of surprise and his tone was a bit unbelievable: "You... are you still from the Su Group?"
Chen Yang's eyes were cold and his tone was firm: "Yes.
Now, pay off this debt immediately and don’t force me to do it. "
